terms.comment: Plural frāga, frāgōrum n. pl., strawberries. Ancient frāgum referred to strawberries known to the ancients. Applying it to today’s cultivated garden strawberry is ordinary modern usage, not a claim that the modern hybrid existed in antiquity.

phrases.latin: Frāga lavā et in catīnum pōne.
phrases.english: Wash the strawberries and put them in the bowl.

sources: The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 73.
